<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>RK Vridhi Digital — Grow Your Business with Smarter Digital Marketing</title>
<meta name="description" content="Rakesh Kumar Prajapati, freelance digital marketing strategist. Personalized, AI-powered marketing strategies for healthcare, retail and local businesses.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --white:#ffffff;
    --bg-soft:#f5f8fd;
    --ink:#0e1b2f;
    --ink-soft:#4c5972;
    --ink-faint:#8a93a8;
    --line:#dfe7f5;
    --blue:#155eef;
    --blue-deep:#0a2f82;
    --blue-pale:#eaf1ff;
    --teal:#0fb8a6;
    --radius-lg:20px;
    --radius-md:14px;
    --radius-sm:10px;
    --shadow-soft:0 20px 60px -20px rgba(10,47,130,.18);
    --shadow-card:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(14,27,47,.12);
    --maxw:1200px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    background:var(--white);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  p{margin:0;}
  .mono{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}
  a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;}
  .eyebrow{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:16px;height:1.5px;background:var(--blue);display:inline-block;}
  section{position:relative;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
    padding:14px 26px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;
    cursor:pointer;border:none;transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  }
  .btn-primary{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--blue-deep));
    color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 30px -10px rgba(21,94,239,.55);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 36px -8px rgba(21,94,239,.65);}
  .btn-outline{
    background:transparent;color:var(--blue);border:1.5px solid var(--blue);
  }
  .btn-outline:hover{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .btn-block{width:100%;}
  .fade-up{opacity:0;transform:translateY(28px);transition:opacity .8s ease, transform .8s ease;}
  .fade-up.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .fade-up{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none;}
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
  }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 24px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;}
  .nav-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .nav-brand img{height:40px;width:auto;}
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:32px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--blue);}
  .nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;}
  @media (max-width:900px){.nav-links{display:none;}}

  /* ---------- GROWTH PATH (signature element) ---------- */
  .growth-path{
    position:fixed;left:26px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
    z-index:50;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  }
  .growth-path .line{position:absolute;top:8px;bottom:8px;left:50%;width:2px;background:var(--line);transform:translateX(-50%);}
  .growth-path .fill{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--teal));transform:translateX(-50%);height:0%;transition:height .35s ease;}
  .gp-node{position:relative;width:34px;height:34px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:2;}
  .gp-node .dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink-faint);transition:all .3s ease;}
  .gp-node.active .dot{background:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px var(--blue-pale);}
  .gp-label{
    position:absolute;left:26px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:11px;
    letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink-soft);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px);transition:all .25s ease;
    background:#fff;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .gp-node:hover .gp-label, .gp-node.active .gp-label{opacity:1;transform:translateX(0);}
  @media (max-width:1180px){.growth-path{display:none;}}

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{padding:96px 0 80px;background:var(--white);overflow:hidden;}
  .hero-shapes{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;}
  .blob{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(60px);opacity:.35;}
  .blob-1{width:420px;height:420px;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--blue-pale),transparent 70%);top:-140px;right:-100px;}
  .blob-2{width:340px;height:340px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#dff5f2,transparent 70%);bottom:-120px;left:-80px;}
  .hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:64px;align-items:center;}
  @media (max-width:960px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px;}}
  .hero-content h1{font-size:clamp(32px,4.2vw,50px);line-height:1.12;margin:18px 0 20px;font-weight:700;}
  .hero-sub{font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:560px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .hero-support{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--ink-soft);max-width:560px;margin-bottom:28px;}
  .badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-bottom:32px;}
  .pill{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;
    background:var(--blue-pale);color:var(--blue-deep);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid #d6e5ff;
  }
  .pill svg{width:13px;height:13px;flex:none;}
  .cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-bottom:30px;}
  .trust-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px 22px;max-width:560px;}
  .trust-list li{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .trust-list li svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--teal);flex:none;}

  /* Profile card */
  .profile-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center;position:relative;}
  .profile-card{
    position:relative;z-index:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.65);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
    border:1px solid rgba(21,94,239,.14);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-soft);padding:34px 30px 28px;text-align:center;max-width:320px;width:100%;
    transition:transform .4s ease, box-shadow .4s ease;
  }
  .profile-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 28px 70px -18px rgba(10,47,130,.28);}
  .profile-photo{
    width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;margin:0 auto 18px;
    border:4px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(10,47,130,.18);
  }
  .profile-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .profile-card h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .profile-card .role{font-size:14px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;}
  .profile-ring{position:absolute;inset:-18px;border:1px dashed rgba(21,94,239,.25);border-radius:28px;z-index:0;}

  /* ---------- TRUST STRIP ---------- */
  .trust-strip{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:26px 0;background:var(--bg-soft);}
  .trust-strip .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px 0;}
  .trust-strip .label{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);font-weight:600;margin-right:26px;}
  .trust-cats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:0;}
  .trust-cats span{padding:0 22px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);position:relative;}
  .trust-cats span:not(:last-child)::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:0;top:2px;bottom:2px;width:1px;background:var(--line);}

  /* ---------- SECTION HEADERS ---------- */
  .section-pad{padding:100px 0;}
  .section-head{max-width:680px;margin:0 auto 56px;text-align:center;}
  .section-head .eyebrow{justify-content:center;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px);margin-bottom:16px;}
  .section-head p{color:var(--ink-soft);font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;}

  /* ---------- STATS ---------- */
  .stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px;margin-bottom:64px;}
  @media (max-width:960px){.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  @media (max-width:520px){.stats-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .stat-card{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:24px 18px;text-align:center;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;
  }
  .stat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -16px rgba(10,47,130,.2);}
  .stat-num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:28px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue-deep);}
  .stat-card p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;}

  /* ---------- CLIENT CARDS ---------- */
  .client-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px;}
  @media (max-width:760px){.client-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .client-card{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:28px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .client-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),var(--teal));}
  .client-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 22px 50px -16px rgba(10,47,130,.22);}
  .client-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .client-top h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .client-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .status-badge{
    font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--teal);background:#e6faf7;
    padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
  }
  .status-badge::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);}
  .client-price{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue-deep);font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .client-outcomes{list-style:none;margin:0 0 16px;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .client-outcomes li{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);display:flex;gap:8px;line-height:1.5;}
  .client-outcomes li svg{width:14px;height:14px;color:var(--blue);flex:none;margin-top:2px;}
  .client-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:14px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-faint);}
  .client-foot .case-btn{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue);}

  .transparency-box{
    margin-top:36px;background:var(--blue-pale);border:1px solid #d6e5ff;border-radius:var(--radius-md);
    padding:24px 26px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .transparency-box svg{width:22px;height:22px;color:var(--blue);flex:none;margin-top:2px;}
  .transparency-box h4{font-size:15.5px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .transparency-box p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.6;}

  /* ---------- PACKAGES ---------- */
  .pkg-scroller{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:16px;}
  @media (max-width:1180px){.pkg-scroller{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);}}
  @media (max-width:760px){.pkg-scroller{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;}}
  .pkg-card{
    background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:26px 22px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease;position:relative;
  }
  .pkg-card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px -16px rgba(10,47,130,.24);}
  .pkg-card.featured{border:2px solid var(--blue);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,var(--blue-pale) 220%);}
  .pkg-badge{
    position:absolute;top:-13px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--blue-deep));
    color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .pkg-name{font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:8px;min-height:44px;}
  .pkg-price{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:24px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue-deep);margin-bottom:14px;}
  .pkg-price span{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:500;}
  .pkg-ideal{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:10px;min-height:52px;}
  .pkg-outcome{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:14px;font-style:italic;min-height:48px;}
  .pkg-list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 20px;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1;}
  .pkg-list li{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);display:flex;gap:7px;line-height:1.5;}
  .pkg-list li svg{width:13px;height:13px;color:var(--blue);flex:none;margin-top:2px;}

  .trial-card{
    margin-top:44px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--blue-deep),var(--blue));
    border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:38px 36px;color:#fff;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;
    box-shadow:0 26px 60px -18px rgba(10,47,130,.5);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .trial-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-60px;top:-60px;width:220px;height:220px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
  @media (max-width:760px){.trial-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;text-align:center;}}
  .trial-badge{display:inline-block;background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);padding:5px 14px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:.03em;}
  .trial-card h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .trial-card .sub{font-size:14px;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .trial-list{list-style:none;margin:0 0 18px;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px 20px;}
  .trial-list li{font-size:13px;display:flex;gap:7px;opacity:.92;}
  .trial-price-box{background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:26px;text-align:center;}
  .trial-price{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:38px;font-weight:700;}
  .trial-price-box .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--blue-deep);box-shadow:none;margin-top:16px;}
  .trial-price-box .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-pale);}

  .note-box{margin-top:40px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:20px 24px;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7;background:var(--bg-soft);}

  /* ---------- PRICING POLICY / FAQ ---------- */
  .policy-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .policy-box{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:26px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);}
  .policy-box h4{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .policy-box ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
  .policy-box li{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.6;}

  .accordion{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);overflow:hidden;background:#fff;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);}
  .accordion-head{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 22px;cursor:pointer;
    font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;user-select:none;
  }
  .accordion-head .plus{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--blue);position:relative;transition:transform .3s ease;}
  .accordion-head .plus::before,.accordion-head .plus::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:var(--blue);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);}
  .accordion-head .plus::before{width:10px;height:1.5px;}
  .accordion-head .plus::after{width:1.5px;height:10px;transition:opacity .25s ease;}
  .accordion.open .plus{transform:rotate(180deg);}
  .accordion.open .plus::after{opacity:0;}
  .accordion-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .35s ease;}
  .accordion-body-in{padding:0 22px 20px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);line-height:1.7;}
  .accordion-body-in ul{margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:18px;}
  .subtabs{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .subtab{padding:10px 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink-soft);background:#fff;}
  .subtab.active{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue);}
  .faq-panel{display:none;}
  .faq-panel.active{display:block;}

  .cta-banner{
    margin-top:60px;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--blue-pale),#fff);
    border:1px solid #d6e5ff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:50px 30px;
  }
  .cta-banner h3{font-size:24px;margin-bottom:18px;}

  /* ---------- CONTACT / BOOKING ---------- */
  .contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr;gap:36px;align-items:flex-start;}
  @media (max-width:900px){.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
  .option-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);overflow:hidden;}
  .option-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:18px 22px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;}
  .option-body{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .35s ease;}
  .option-body-in{padding:0 22px 20px;}
  .option-body-in p.hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.6;}
  textarea{
    width:100%;min-height:110px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:14px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);resize:vertical;outline:none;transition:border .2s ease;
  }
  textarea:focus{border-color:var(--blue);}
  .char-count{text-align:right;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-faint);margin-top:6px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}

  .whatsapp-card{
    background:linear-gradient(140deg,#0a2f82,#155eef);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    padding:32px 28px;text-align:center;position:sticky;top:100px;
  }
  .whatsapp-card h3{font-size:19px;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .whatsapp-card p{font-size:13.5px;opacity:.85;margin-bottom:20px;line-height:1.6;}
  .whatsapp-card .btn-primary{background:#fff;color:var(--blue-deep);box-shadow:none;width:100%;}
  .whatsapp-card .btn-primary:hover{background:var(--blue-pale);}
  .whatsapp-card .num{margin-top:14px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:13px;opacity:.8;}

  .success-msg{display:none;background:#e6faf7;border:1px solid #b9ede6;border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:18px 22px;font-size:13.5px;color:#0a6b60;margin-top:16px;line-height:1.6;}
  .success-msg.show{display:block;}

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer{background:var(--ink);color:#cfd7e8;padding:64px 0 30px;}
  .footer-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:36px;margin-bottom:40px;}
  .footer-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .footer-brand img{height:38px;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:4px;}
  .footer-brand span{font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;font-weight:600;color:#fff;font-size:16px;}
  .social-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
  .social-links a{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #263352;
    font-size:13px;color:#cfd7e8;transition:all .25s ease;
  }
  .social-links a:hover{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
  .social-links svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
  footer .bottom{border-top:1px solid #223050;padding-top:22px;font-size:12.5px;color:#7c8aa8;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;}

  /* ---------- FLOATING BUTTONS ---------- */
  .floating{position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;z-index:80;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:14px;}
  .fab{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;border:none;
    box-shadow:0 14px 34px -10px rgba(14,27,47,.35);transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
    animation:fabIn .6s ease both;
  }
  .fab:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.03);}
  @keyframes fabIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}
  .fab-consult{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue),var(--blue-deep));color:#fff;padding:14px 20px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;}
  .fab-whatsapp{background:#25D366;color:#fff;width:58px;height:58px;justify-content:center;padding:0;}
  .fab-whatsapp svg{width:28px;height:28px;}
  @media (max-width:600px){
    .fab-consult span{display:none;}
    .fab-consult{padding:14px;width:58px;height:58px;justify-content:center;}
  }

  /* ---------- MODAL ---------- */
  .modal-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,20,40,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:100;
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
  }
  .modal-overlay.show{display:flex;}
  .modal{
    background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);max-width:460px;width:100%;padding:32px;
    max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;position:relative;box-shadow:0 40px 90px -20px rgba(10,20,40,.4);
    animation:modalIn .3s ease;
  }
  @keyframes modalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}}
  .modal-close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-soft);border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .modal h3{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .modal .sub{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:22px;line-height:1.6;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink-soft);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .field input{
    width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:12px 14px;font-size:13.5px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;outline:none;transition:border .2s ease;
  }
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--blue);}
  .field textarea{min-height:90px;}
</style>
</head>

<script>
  const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "917837897701";

  // ---- fade-up on scroll ----
  const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(e=>{ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } });
  },{threshold:.15});
  fadeEls.forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

  // ---- animated counters ----
  const counters = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-num');
  const counterIO = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{
    entries.forEach(entry=>{
      if(entry.isIntersecting){
        const el = entry.target;
        const target = parseInt(el.dataset.count,10);
        const suffix = el.dataset.suffix || "";
        if(target > 3000){ el.textContent = target; counterIO.unobserve(el); return; } // year, don't count up
        let cur = 0;
        const step = Math.max(1, Math.round(target/40));
        const tick = ()=>{
          cur += step;
          if(cur >= target){ el.textContent = target + suffix; }
          else{ el.textContent = cur + suffix; requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
        };
        tick();
        counterIO.unobserve(el);
      }
    });
  },{threshold:.4});
  counters.forEach(c=>counterIO.observe(c));

  // ---- accordions (terms + faq) ----
  document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-head').forEach(head=>{
    head.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const acc = head.parentElement;
      const body = acc.querySelector('.accordion-body');
      const isOpen = acc.classList.contains('open');
      // close siblings within same panel
      acc.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.accordion.open').forEach(o=>{
        if(o!==acc){ o.classList.remove('open'); o.querySelector('.accordion-body').style.maxHeight = null; }
      });
      if(isOpen){ acc.classList.remove('open'); body.style.maxHeight = null; }
      else{ acc.classList.add('open'); body.style.maxHeight = body.scrollHeight + "px"; }
    });
  });

  // ---- FAQ subtabs ----
  document.querySelectorAll('.subtab').forEach(tab=>{
    tab.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      document.querySelectorAll('.subtab').forEach(t=>t.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-panel').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('panel-'+tab.dataset.tab).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // ---- booking form option cards (expand) ----
  document.querySelectorAll('.option-head').forEach(head=>{
    head.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      const card = head.parentElement;
      const body = card.querySelector('.option-body');
      const isOpen = card.classList.contains('open');
      if(isOpen){ card.classList.remove('open'); body.style.maxHeight = null; }
      else{ card.classList.add('open'); body.style.maxHeight = body.scrollHeight + "px"; }
    });
  });

  // ---- character counters ----
  document.querySelectorAll('textarea[data-counter]').forEach(t=>{
    const counterEl = document.getElementById(t.dataset.counter);
    t.addEventListener('input', ()=>{ counterEl.textContent = t.value.length; });
  });
  const cGoal = document.getElementById('cGoal');
  cGoal.addEventListener('input', ()=>{ document.getElementById('cGoalCount').textContent = cGoal.value.length; });

  // ---- WhatsApp quick links ----
  const baseWaMsg = encodeURIComponent("Hello Rakesh, I want to discuss my business growth requirements.");
  document.getElementById('quickWhatsapp').href = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${baseWaMsg}`;
  document.getElementById('floatWhatsapp').href = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${baseWaMsg}`;
  document.getElementById('footerWhatsapp').href = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${baseWaMsg}`;

  // ---- Strategy call form submit ----
  document.getElementById('strategyForm').addEventListener('submit', (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const vals = ['c1','c2','c3','c4'].map(id=>{
      const ta = document.querySelector(`textarea[data-counter="${id}"]`);
      return ta.value.trim();
    });
    const msg = `New Strategy Call Request%0A%0ABusiness Details:%0A${encodeURIComponent(vals[0]||'-')}%0A%0AContact Details:%0A${encodeURIComponent(vals[1]||'-')}%0A%0ADesired Results & Expectations:%0A${encodeURIComponent(vals[2]||'-')}%0A%0ASuggestions:%0A${encodeURIComponent(vals[3]||'-')}%0A%0AWebsite:%20https://www.rkvridhidigital.com`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
    document.getElementById('formSuccess').classList.add('show');
    e.target.reset();
    document.querySelectorAll('textarea[data-counter]').forEach(t=>{ document.getElementById(t.dataset.counter).textContent = 0; });
  });

  // ---- Consult modal ----
  const overlay = document.getElementById('consultOverlay');
  document.getElementById('openConsultModal').addEventListener('click', ()=>overlay.classList.add('show'));
  document.getElementById('closeConsultModal').addEventListener('click', ()=>overlay.classList.remove('show'));
  overlay.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target===overlay) overlay.classList.remove('show'); });

  document.getElementById('consultForm').addEventListener('submit', (e)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const name = document.getElementById('cName').value.trim();
    const business = document.getElementById('cBusiness').value.trim();
    const category = document.getElementById('cCategory').value.trim();
    const goal = document.getElementById('cGoal').value.trim();
    const mobile = document.getElementById('cMobile').value.trim();
    const msg = `New Consultation Request%0A%0AName:%20${encodeURIComponent(name)}%0ABusiness:%20${encodeURIComponent(business)}%0ACategory:%20${encodeURIComponent(category)}%0ARequirement:%20${encodeURIComponent(goal)}%0AMobile:%20${encodeURIComponent(mobile)}%0A%0AWebsite:%20https://www.rkvridhidigital.com`;
    window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${msg}`, '_blank');
    document.getElementById('consultSuccess').classList.add('show');
    e.target.reset();
    document.getElementById('cGoalCount').textContent = 0;
  });

  // ---- Growth path (signature scroll tracker) ----
  const gpNodes = document.querySelectorAll('.gp-node');
  const gpFill = document.getElementById('gpFill');
  const sectionIds = ['hero','results','packages','faq','contact'];
  const sections = sectionIds.map(id=>document.getElementById(id));

  gpNodes.forEach(node=>{
    node.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      document.getElementById(node.dataset.target).scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });

  function updateGrowthPath(){
    let activeIdx = 0;
    const scrollPos = window.scrollY + window.innerHeight/2.5;
    sections.forEach((sec,i)=>{
      if(sec && sec.offsetTop <= scrollPos) activeIdx = i;
    });
    gpNodes.forEach((n,i)=>n.classList.toggle('active', i===activeIdx));
    const totalHeight = document.getElementById('growthPath').offsetHeight - 16;
    const pct = activeIdx/(sectionIds.length-1);
    gpFill.style.height = (pct*totalHeight) + "px";
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateGrowthPath, {passive:true});
  updateGrowthPath();
</script>

</body>
</html>
